featured.caption: The bank vault with its round door swung open.
The bank vault door, closed.
The rebuilt market on the square, seen from above.
The juicer on a market table.
The farmer, dressed for the job, ready to talk.
The strongbox beside the cash van, with an evidence marker on the grass.
An ore rock at the quarry with a gold vein.
The spawn square: cobbles, the welcome sign and the payphone, with the village street beyond.
The general store with its sign, shop window and counter out front.
The fuel station on the main street: canopy, kiosk and till.
The village hospital with the ambulance parked in its bay.
The police post: duty desk, dispatch and wanted boards, and a jeep out front.
The car lot: four cars for sale, each with its price board.
The bank front with its two teller windows, one on each side of the door.
The farm: house, greenhouse and a worn cart track in the evening light.
A payphone box beside the fuel station canopy.
The hospital front: name plate, Red Cross banner, dispatch board and duty desk.
The ambulance bay sign at the edge of the bay, with the ambulance in its lane.
Money sacks beside the cash van after its steel box is drilled open.
The fence's yard: Vince in front of the barn, with his bench, tyres and a barrel.
The lock-up row on the main street, a wooden door set in a yellow wall.
The chop shop yard: an engine on the pad at sunset, bench and tyres along the wall.
The hideout workbench under the pergola, with the evening sun low over the wall.
The moonshine still, a boiler tank with its furnace and stack, under spruce.
The lawless quarry: the lane barrier, a warning sign and granite walls behind.
